_documentation.model_purpose: Point-in-Time Real Expected Value (EV) Raw Probability Table for Wave Microstructure (W x σVc x σc x vel)
_documentation.return_formula: Real Return = (Price(t_pivot_next) / Close(t)) - 1. Zero Ghost Return bias.
_documentation.horizon_gate: Maximum horizon = 120 days. Captures micro wave timing to next ZigZag pivot (2.5%, 5.0%, 7.5%).

state_hierarchy.L1: Full 4D State: W_slope|σVc|σc|vel_σVw (450 granular micro timing states)
state_hierarchy.L2: Mid-Micro State: W_slope|σVc (30 mid-wave cycle states)
state_hierarchy.L3: Wave Direction State: W_slope (6 macro wave slope states)

field_glossary.n_samples: Total sample size of historical bars observed in this micro state
field_glossary.p_max: P(next pivot = MAX). Empirical probability of next pivot being a high (+)
field_glossary.p_min: P(next pivot = MIN). Empirical probability of next pivot being a low (-)
field_glossary.e_ret_max: Expected real upside gain % to next MAX pivot
field_glossary.e_ret_min: Expected real drawdown % to next MIN pivot
field_glossary.lift_bottom: Ratio vs market baseline probability of finding a bottom
field_glossary.lift_top: Ratio vs market baseline probability of finding a top
field_glossary.fatigue_buckets: Performance metrics grouped by run_length (1, 2, 3-4, 5-7, 8-10, 11+ bars)

_documentation.rare_event_policy: Cells with N < 30 represent low frequency micro-wave configurations. Samples N >= 1 are preserved pure in the Fact Store for Empirical Bayes parent fallback at evaluation time.

description: Fact Store con las mediciones empíricas puras de retornos forward a pivotes ZigZag (2.5%, 5.0%, 7.5%)
